artifact_observations.reasoning: The tip of the iron features a large, nonsensical V-shaped cutout/gap. Standard irons have a solid, continuous pointed tip. This structural break suggests a generation error or a physically non-functional design.
The steam holes lack depth; they appear as flat dark circles rather than recessed apertures, lacking the internal shadowing expected in a macro shot of a metal plate.
Slight blurring and warping at the boundary between the transparent plastic tank and the metal body, suggesting minor fusion or edge bleeding.
